title: Design System: HTML Web Courses EN

motion.name: promo-enter
motion.purpose: Single soft promo entrance; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tab-settle
motion.purpose: Tab color and underline settle without pulse glow.

components.name: Course Tab Selected
components.css: .ds-tab { font: 400 0.9375rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; color: #6e6e73; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 10px 2px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-on { color: #0066cc; font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: #0066cc; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Outline pill for copying code or promo.
components.css: .ds-copy { font: 500 0.8125rem/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius: 980px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1f; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy:hover { background: #f5f5f7; } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Promo Code Chip
components.description: Pill showing the Advanced course code.
components.css: .ds-promo-code { font: 600 0.8125rem/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 980px; background: #f5f5f7; color: #0066cc; }

components.name: Code Well
components.description: Light bordered pre block for lesson snippets.
components.css: .ds-pre { margin: 0; background: #f5f5f7; color: #1d1d1f; border: 1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font: 0.8125rem/1.5 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; overflow-x: auto; }

narrative.overview: Course teaching script restyled as an Apple Support–quiet document: white paper, system SF stack, blue text wayfinding, hairline rules. Content order and curriculum stay fixed; only chrome and type change.
keyCharacteristics: No thick accent side-bars on narration

rules.name: Content Freeze
rules.body: Do not change lesson copy, code samples, or tab order when extending the system.

rules.name: Quiet Motion
rules.body: One soft promo entrance; no continuous pulse glow.

dos: Do keep English chrome, unique section ids, and PROMO_CODE_HERE aligned with Block 15.
donts: Don't reintroduce orange promotional AI chrome or thick accent side bars on narration.
Don't change lesson copy, code samples, or tab order when extending the system.
